title: Operator Yes/No 'did you place this?' prompts only for manual-bridge prop accounts
note: PI-20261007-JOHNSXDJ-0002. Scan-level exclusion already live via #17007 (running sha 9709fbf3a includes it). PR #17379 adds the guard at the source: emit_prop_expiry_prompt and emit_prop_invalidation_prompt refuse rest/phone/browser accounts (velotrade_1, breakout_2, tradeify_1); only breakout_1 (manual) can be prompted. CLOSING OBSERVATION: after #17379 is merged and deployed (git_sha_running descends from it), there are 0 'refused for machine-executed' lines AND 0 'prop_invalidation_prompt: warned' lines for a machine account in ict-trader-live journalctl over a window where a machine-account ticket existed. Not measured this session: prop_tickets is not on the diag allowlist, and the journal relay only covers about 11 minutes.

observation.what: after #17379 is deployed (git_sha_running descends from it), no prop_invalidation_prompt warned line and no Yes/No prompt is sent for velotrade_1, breakout_2 or tradeify_1 while one of their tickets is emitted; breakout_1 (manual) still can be prompted
observation.how_to_check: bash scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh 'journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&lines=2000' | grep -E 'prop_invalidation_prompt: warned|refused for machine-executed'
